agent.finish_summary: Fixed _ComplementSet.__lt__ in boltons/setutils.py: inverted NotImplemented guard (`if not (inc is NotImplemented)`) was causing `<` comparisons between _ComplementSet and set to raise TypeError. Changed to `if inc is NotImplemented: return NotImplemented`, matching the correct pattern in __le__/__ge__/__gt__. Verified fix with manual test script covering all comparison directions; removed the temporary test script afterward.
